basis.method: Use the committed 861-name snapshot denominator as the baseline, parse live callable names from liveSyntax in the live-reference integrity report, normalize generic constructor syntax to Pine call names, then add live-documented callable names absent from the committed snapshot. Parameter-only divergences are not new member names.

interpretation.honestCoverageFigure: 813/886 (91.76%) is the current answer to how much of the live-documented Pine member surface the vectors cover, using the committed snapshot plus the live callable-name correction.
interpretation.artifactCoverageFigure: 813/861 (94.43%) remains useful only as coverage against the committed snapshot artifact.
interpretation.limit: The live-reference integrity report is callable-focused; constants and declarations still come from the committed snapshot until a fully refreshed live reference denominator replaces it.
